_about: F65 THE ENDING (design/story.md 'The ending — save the goop', TDD D28): what plays after the final shift's third valve stage opens, in order (src/game/ending.ts) — in the tank: the goop pours out (pour) and speaks through its mouths (goopLines, mouths) · F75: if the Veteran made it through the final shift, the happy ending — his white clump rises with the goop (vet) and he says his lines out loud (vetLines), and the speaker's line + quiet don't come · at the console (he didn't make it): the Veteran's last clear line, then the speaker quiet for good · the last payday · the badge rewritten on the monitor · you leave: the goop carries you out · the empty console · the end-game screen and its new career. Words: content/text/en.json ending. Seconds run on the looks clock (the Dev Kit's full pause holds them); read when used, so Dev Kit edits apply to the next ending.

_help.goopLines: The goop's lines out loud, in order (keys in en.json ending.goop). Each waits for a tap.
_help.vetLines: F75 the happy ending (the Veteran made it): his lines out loud after the goop's, in order (keys in en.json ending.vetSaved), in his bubble from his clump. Each waits for a tap.
_help.vet.spot: F75 the happy ending: where his white clump sits in the goop once it has filled the view — [share of the width, share of the height]. He rises with it.
_help.vet.size: His clump's width (share of the view's smaller side).
_help.paidBy: How many former employees paid off your passage debt — the last payday, and the goop's '{more}' line.
_help.named: How many of them the goop names in its 'names' line ('{more}' = paidBy − named).
_help.pour.shakeSeconds: The tank opens: how long the view shakes first.
_help.pour.shake: How far it shakes (share of the screen's width).
_help.pour.seconds: How long the goop takes to rise from the bottom and fill the whole periscope view.
_help.pour.holdSeconds: The view full of goop, quiet, before it speaks.
_help.pour.lumps: How many blobs along the goop's rising edge.
_help.pour.lumpSize: How big those blobs are (share of the screen's width).
_help.pour.stars: How many star specks twinkle in it (galaxy-look.json colours).
_help.mouths.spots: Each face's middle in the goop that filled the view: [share of the width, share of the height]. The lines go to them one after another.
_help.mouths.size: A mouth's width (share of the view's smaller side). Eyes, pupils and mouth colours: eyes.json; every mouth opens at once on each line (eyes.json chorusTime, chorusOpen — the rank-48 chorus).
_help.console.quietSeconds: After the Veteran's last line: the speaker quiet, before the last payday.
_help.console.strikeAfterSeconds: The badge: after it comes up, how long before the goop starts crossing out your title (the monitor glitches first).
_help.console.strikeSeconds: How long the goop's line through your title takes to draw.
_help.console.leaveSeconds: You leave: the goop rising over the console, carrying you out, and draining away.
_help.console.emptySeconds: The empty console, before the end-game screen (a tap moves on sooner).
